title: EvoSyn：基于学习反馈的多智能体数据合成框架
summary: 提出EvoSyn，一种学习反馈驱动的多智能体数据合成框架，通过可修订状态组织合成过程，将学习者反馈转化为合成修订，实现合成空间的适应与扩展。在τ²-Bench和CAR-Bench上平均任务成功率提升13.3个百分点，并生成更高质量、结构更广的合成经验。
summary_en: Proposes EvoSyn, a learning-feedback-driven multi-agent framework for data synthesis that organizes synthesis around a revisable state, translating learner feedback into synthesis revisions to enable within-space adaptation and synthesis-space expansion. On τ²-Bench and CAR-Bench, it improves average task success by 13.3 points over the strongest baseline, producing higher-quality and structurally broader synthetic experience.
